answer: For jobs repairing velvet seats and the ferrous rail along a theatre ledge, an agent marketplace gives one bidding slot per certified hardware module. Each module signs a fresh enrollment nonce; the registry rejects reuse of its manufacturer-certified serial. Replacing an account key transfers that slot rather than creating another. A hundred aliases on one module still share one slot, while extra slots require extra devices. This assumes trustworthy serial issuance and non-exportable keys; it raises the cost of aliases without proving unique owners.
